findings: src/game.js resolve pushes tanks through the outer wall after clamping: with player at (18.8,0), heading 90, and computer at (17,1.6), one forward step puts the player at x=18.8437.

src/ai.js stalls indefinitely at legal wall-contact positions: with computer at (-10.2,8) and player at (0,8), its inflated clearance check rejects every movement target, producing no movement or shots within 30 seconds.

src/shells.js misses grazing hits by checking only step endpoints: firing from (-5,0), heading 0, past a computer at (0.225,1.449) leaves its health unchanged despite intersecting its collision circle.
src/scene.js crops the arena at portrait window sizes such as 800×1280 because resize changes the camera aspect without adjusting its framing, violating the requirement to show the whole arena.

src/ai.js repeatedly selects an already reached waypoint: placing the player at (-10.2, 8) leaves the computer stuck near (-7.8, 0) without firing after 120 seconds, violating the requirement to find a hidden player.
src/shells.js ignores exact tank contact because it uses a strict distance comparison: firing from (-5, 0), heading 0, past a computer at (0, 1.45) causes no damage despite the shell touching it.

src/shells.js reflects only one velocity component at diagonal corner contacts: firing from (-11, -3), heading 315, into the corner at (-9, -5) sends the shell southwest instead of reflecting it back toward its shooter.

src/ai.js pickTarget strands the computer behind a wall: with player at (-10.2, 8) and computer at (-5.8, 8), it stops at (-4.0849, 8.2088) and neither moves nor fires through 90 seconds, violating Done when 9.

src/shells.js checks wall overlap only at step endpoints, allowing a shell fired from (-10.7493821807, -6.3972429996) at heading 45 to pass within 0.249 units of corner (-9, -5) without bouncing, despite its 0.25 radius; the passing 26-test suite misses this collision.
